name: Sara Aapi
overview: Sara Aapi is the story of a woman who sacrificed her dreams and the most precious years of her youth to give her three brothers the best upbringing. After the sudden death of her parents, Sara takes control of both the family and the business. She turns them into success stories, but at the cost of her own personal life. Her world revolves around her brothers, Burhan, Adnan, and Usman. Over time, Sara becomes strict and commanding. Her decisions become law inside the house. But her strongest test begins when her brothers' personal desires rise against her authority. Soon, tensions grow and loyalties are tested.
